critical_code_review_comments: BatchStudioSheet.jsx uses React.useMemo (line 52) but only imports { useState } from 'react'. Works because React default import is in scope, but for consistency with the rest of the codebase, import useMemo explicitly (`import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react'`).

isPastAlarm reactivity is time-of-render only. If the user leaves the alarm picker open past the picked minute, the disabled state won't refresh automatically. Consider a lightweight interval (or re-evaluate on Apply click) to catch this edge case. Not blocking.

The AlertDialog description says 'attachments will be permanently removed from this device' but StorageService.deleteNote only removes the note row - if attachments live in a separate 'files' store they may be orphaned. Verify attachment cleanup or soften the copy.

useBulkActions hook cleanly extracts ~200 lines from NotesApp.jsx (now ~1443 lines). Refactor looks correct and all bulk regression tests pass unchanged. Follow-up: extract MoveToCategoryModal + CopySuffixDialog wiring in a future pass to further shrink NotesApp.jsx.
List/accordion view (data-testid='accordion-note-<id>') still cannot enter select mode - parity gap from iterations 9/10 remains open (unrelated to this refactor, tracked previously).
seed_data_creation: Direct IndexedDB writes into IronRabbit -> notes store using store.put(value, id) (out-of-line keys). Each test re-seeds 2-3 TestBS-category notes with predictable IDs (bs1, bs2, bs3) then reloads the page so the app hydrates from IndexedDB.
